body_html:
Holy Cow this was a party. This wedding was not only beautiful but this group of people know how to rage it New Orleans style. Dance party, check. Great food, check. Time of your life…double check! Mile High Station is a great place to host any event, and the Bresler Wedding takes the cake this weekend. Congrats to the new couple and we send our best wishes. Thanks for having JAMMIN DJ’s be a part of it all!

 

DJ Herb
